scope: Missing Other Super skills from current Xenoverse 2 taxonomy

records.name: Giga Boost
records.effect: Utility Super Skill used by Dodoria.
records.evidence_boundary: Current Xenoverse 2 reference independently confirms Giga Boost debuted as Dodoria's skill and is obtainable by the Future Warrior from the Conton City Skill Shop; numeric Ki cost remains unresolved.

records.name: Holstein Shock
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 15 — Gotta Find That Dragon Ball!
records.effect: Captain Ginyu utility Super that damages its user.
records.evidence_boundary: Current Xenoverse 2 references confirm Holstein Shock is Captain Ginyu's Super Skill and a PQ15 reward; numeric Ki cost remains unresolved.

records.name: Emperor's Sign
records.effect: Frieza fighting-pose Super whose effects vary by race.
records.evidence_boundary: Current Xenoverse 2 references confirm Emperor's Sign is Frieza's Super Skill and is obtainable from the TP Medal Shop; numeric Ki cost remains unresolved.

records.name: Time Control
records.effect: User takes a stance and freezes the enemy in place, trapping them in a barrier for a few seconds.

records.name: Position Shift
records.unlock_method: Skill Shop after defeating Kid Buu
records.effect: Utility Super that shifts the user's position.
records.evidence_boundary: Current Xenoverse 2 references confirm Position Shift is Towa's Super Skill and is obtainable from the Skill Shop after defeating Kid Buu; numeric Ki cost remains unresolved.

notes: The current Xenoverse 2 Super Attack page places all five in Other. Future Warrior technique documentation identifies their users. None of the retrieved sources exposed a numeric Ki cost, so all four costs remain unresolved. 2026-09-25 acquisition-endpoint refresh: populated four previously-null unlock_method fields from direct Xenoverse 2-specific evidence: Giga Boost → Conton City Skill Shop; Holstein Shock → PQ15; Emperor's Sign → TP Medal Shop; Position Shift → Skill Shop after defeating Kid Buu.
